item.text: I’m going to add a compact daily planning board with local persistence, drag-and-drop columns, search, import/export, and a responsive layout. It will be a single `index.html`, so there’s nothing to install.
The file is in place. I’m doing a quick syntax and portability pass now, then I’ll patch any issues that show up.
The JavaScript parses cleanly and the file is ASCII-only. I spotted one browser-compatibility weak point around ID generation, so I’m tightening that and giving the search box a stable toolbar width.
I’m making the importer and saved-data loader stricter as well, so a malformed JSON task can’t break rendering later.
One last durability patch: persistence will now fail quietly if the browser blocks local storage, keeping the board usable for the current session.
The implementation is done; I’m running the final lightweight checks now.

I made a standalone local task board: [index.html](/workspace/index.html).

It’s a responsive Dayline planner with Inbox/Today/Later/Done columns, drag-and-drop, search, due dates, priorities, local persistence, import/export, and clear-done. It opens directly in a browser, no server or install needed.
